message.content:
This is a POS (point-of-sale) system called KasirKu, being migrated from a single-file HTML/localStorage prototype to a Next.js + Supabase app. The prototype is at G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\docs\reference\pos-system_1.html (7340 lines) — it's the original reference implementation containing ALL the business logic and UI features that should eventually exist in the new app. It should NOT be run, just read as reference.

The new app lives under G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\(dashboard)\ with these sections so far: activity, attendance, cashiers, customers, finance, ingredients, payroll, products, reports, settings, shifts, tables, transactions — plus a separate `pos` page for the checkout screen. There's also self-order (QR scan) under src/app/order/[qrSlug]. Supabase migrations covering the schema/RPCs live in G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\supabase\migrations\ (19 files, covering: businesses/cashiers, products/ingredients/recipes, shifts/transactions, finance tables, F&B support tables (self-order, tables, kitchen printers, custom payment methods), activity log, cashier PIN RPC, checkout RPC, shift close RPC, recipe consumption, self-order RPC, void transaction RPC, discounts/tax, open bills, stock adjustments, customers, low stock threshold, cashier management, payroll).

Your task: Read through the prototype HTML file (docs/reference/pos-system_1.html) in full — it likely has clear sections (look for comments, function names, tab/page names, modal names, feature names like "diskon", "void", "shift", "laporan", "cetak struk", "kasir", "produk", "bahan baku", "pelanggan", "meja", "self order", "printer dapur", "gaji"/"payroll", "absensi", etc.). Build a list of ALL distinct user-facing features/modules present in the prototype.

Then cross-reference against the current Next.js app by looking at the relevant page files under src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/*/page.tsx (and subpages), src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/, src/app/order/[qrSlug]/, and the migrations listed above, to determine for each prototype feature whether it appears to be: (a) already implemented in the new app, (b) partially implemented, or (c) missing/not yet ported.

Report back a structured list: Feature name — status (done/partial/missing) — one-line note on what's different or missing. Focus on user-facing functionality, not code structure. Keep the report organized by module (Kasir/POS, Produk & Bahan Baku, Shift, Transaksi, Keuangan, Pelanggan, Meja/Self-order, Pegawai/Payroll, Pengaturan, Laporan, dll). Be thorough — this is the main point of the task. Aim for a complete, accurate diff, not a quick skim.

## Feature Comparison: KasirKu Prototype vs. New Next.js/Supabase App

Based on my thorough analysis of the prototype HTML file (`docs/reference/pos-system_1.html`) and the new Next.js/Supabase application, here is a comprehensive list of all user-facing features with their implementation status:

### **KASIR / POS (Checkout Screen)**
- **Product Catalog & Search** — partial (search/categories exist in migration but no dedicated POS UI built yet; pos folder exists but empty)
- **Add to Cart** — missing (no client-side POS interface yet)
- **Barcode Scanner** — missing (references in migrations but no UI)
- **Split Payment / Multi-Method Checkout** — missing (checkout_rpc exists but no UI)
- **Item-Level Discount** — missing (discount logic in migrations but no UI)
- **Order-Level Discount** — missing
- **Item Notes / Special Instructions** — missing
- **Receipt Printing** — missing (no printer integration UI)
- **Receipt Sharing (WhatsApp, Email)** — missing
- **Receipt Save as HTML** — missing
- **Quick Reprint Transaction** — missing

### **PRODUK / INVENTORY MANAGEMENT**
- **Add/Edit/Delete Products** — done (src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/products/page.tsx)
- **Product Photos** — partial (emoji support, but not full image upload/storage)
- **Product Categories** — done (category field in products)
- **Stock Management** — done (stock_adjustments table & UI)
- **Price & Cost (HPP) per Product** — done (price and cost fields)
- **Barcode Management** — partial (field exists in DB/migrations but no barcode scanner UI)
- **Stock Threshold / Low Stock Alerts** — partial (low_stock_threshold migration exists but no UI/alerts)

### **BAHAN BAKU / INGREDIENTS (F&B Only)**
- **Ingredient Master (Add/Edit/Delete)** — done (ingredients page exists)
- **Ingredient Unit & Cost Tracking** — done (unit and cost fields in ingredients)
- **Ingredient Stock Management** — done (migrations support this)
- **Inventory Value Summary** — partial (low_stock_threshold exists but not full summary UI)
- **Recipe Builder (Ingredients per Product)** — done (recipe page under products/[productId]/recipe/)
- **HPP Calculator from Recipes** — partial (references in prototype but UI not fully ported)
- **Ingredient Consumption Tracking** — done (recipe_consumption RPC exists)
- **Opening Inventory Adjustment** — partial (set_opening_inventory_form exists but not visible in interface)

### **MEJA / TABLES & SELF-ORDER (F&B Only)**
- **Add/Edit/Delete Tables** — done (tables page with add/delete UI)
- **Table QR Code Generation** — done (qr_slug management in tables)
- **Self-Order Menu per Table** — done (order/[qrSlug]/ page implements customer-facing order screen)
- **Self-Order Inbox (Manager View)** — partial (tables page shows incoming orders but limited UI for status management)
- **Order Status Management (New → Processing → Done)** — partial (statuses in DB, limited UI)
- **Add Self-Order to Cashier Cart** — partial (order creation works, but integration with POS checkout unclear)

### **PRINTER DAPUR / KITCHEN PRINTERS (F&B Only)**
- **Add/Edit/Delete Kitchen Printers** — done (add-printer-form, delete-printer-button in settings)
- **Bluetooth Connection Setup** — partial (form fields exist but no active Bluetooth scanning/pairing UI)
- **LAN/Network Setup** — partial (form fields exist but no connection testing UI)
- **Printer Categories/Routing** — done (categories field in kitchen_printers table)
- **Auto-Print on Checkout by Category** — partial (RPC logic exists, but no visible "print order" UI at checkout)
- **Test Print** — missing (no test print button/function visible)

### **SHIFT MANAGEMENT**
- **Open Shift (with Opening Cash)** — missing (no dedicated UI; shifts created via RPC only)
- **Close Shift (with Closing Cash & Reconciliation)** — done (shifts page shows history; close logic exists in RPC)
- **Shift Summary Report** — partial (shifts page displays data, but no print/export report)
- **Shift Duration Display** — missing (UI reference exists but not fully integrated)
- **Expected vs. Actual Cash Count** — partial (logic in RPC, but display limited)
- **Shift-Level Void Count** — partial (tracked in shifts but display minimal)

### **TRANSAKSI / TRANSACTIONS**
- **Transaction History (All Filters)** — done (transactions page with 50 most recent)
- **Transaction Detail View** — partial (linked view exists, details limited)
- **Search/Filter by Date Range** — partial (basic date filtering, no advanced filters)
- **Void Transaction (Manager PIN Required)** — done (void_transaction_rpc exists, but no UI for cashier/manager to trigger void from POS)
- **Transaction Reprintable Receipt** — missing (no reprint UI in transactions view)
- **Transaction Split Payments Detail View** — partial (split payment data in DB, but view limited)

### **PEMBAYARAN / PAYMENT METHODS**
- **Cash Payment** — missing (no checkout UI)
- **Card Payment** — missing
- **QRIS** — missing
- **Custom Payment Methods** — done (add/manage custom payment methods in settings)
- **Multiple Payment Methods per Transaction (Split)** — done (transaction_payments table + split_payment logic in RPC)
- **Payment Method Fees/Merchant Fees** — partial (tax_enabled, tax_rate fields exist but logic for merchant fee deduction unclear)

### **DISKON / DISCOUNT**
- **Item-Level Discount (Percentage or Fixed)** — missing (discount logic in checkout_rpc but no UI)
- **Order-Level Discount** — missing (discount logic in RPC but no UI)
- **Discount Presets** — missing

### **PAJAK & BIAYA LAYANAN / TAX & SERVICE CHARGE**
- **Tax Enable/Disable Toggle** — done (tax_enabled, tax_rate in businesses table)
- **Tax Rate Setting** — done (tax_rate field, TaxServiceForm UI exists)
- **Service Charge Enable/Disable** — done (service_enabled, service_rate in businesses)
- **Service Charge Rate Setting** — done (service_rate field in businesses)
- **Automatic Calculation on Checkout** — partial (logic in checkout_rpc, but no UI to verify before final payment)

### **KEUANGAN / FINANCE & ACCOUNTING**
- **Revenue Dashboard (Today/7 Days/Month/All)** — done (page/dashboard shows KPI cards)
- **Expense Tracking (Add/Edit/Delete)** — done (add-expense-form, delete button in finance page)
- **Expense Categories** — done (predefined categories + custom option)
- **Payment Reconciliation (POS vs. Actual Received)** — partial (reconciliation form exists in finance page, but UI limited)
- **Merchant Fee Tracking per Payment Method** — partial (field structure exists but no clear UI for input)
- **COGS Tracking (Theory vs. Actual)** — partial (concept exists in prototype, limited implementation in new app)
- **Opening Inventory Value Manual Override** — done (set-opening-inventory-form exists)
- **Profit/Loss Calculation** — partial (basic math in dashboard, COGS comparison logic incomplete)

### **LAPORAN / REPORTS**
- **Sales Dashboard (Revenue, Transaction Count, Void Count)** — done (page/dashboard shows metrics)
- **Sales by Period (Today/7 Days/Month/All/Custom)** — done (period selector with custom date range)
- **Profit & Loss (Laba Rugi) Report** — partial (laba-rugi subpage exists but may be incomplete)
- **Inventory Valuation Report** — missing (no dedicated inventory report)
- **Shift Summary Print** — missing (shift data shown but no print format)
- **Export to CSV/Excel** — partial (export API route exists, but limited export options visible)
- **Sales Trend Chart** — missing (no charts/graphs visible yet)

### **PELANGGAN / CUSTOMERS**
- **Add/Edit/Delete Customers** — done (customers page with add/edit/delete UI)
- **Customer Phone & Email** — done (fields in customer table)
- **Customer Purchase History** — done (customer detail page links to transactions)
- **Customer Total Spending** — partial (data available, UI display minimal)
- **Customer Notes** — missing

### **KASIR / CASHIER MANAGEMENT**
- **Add/Edit/Delete Cashiers** — done (cashiers page with full UI)
- **Cashier PIN Management** — done (pin field in cashier table, reset-pin-form exists)
- **Cashier Role (Kasir/Manajer)** — done (role selection in add/edit forms)
- **Manajer-Only: Void Transactions** — partial (role-based access in DB, but void UI missing from POS)
- **Manajer-Only: PIN Reset for Others** — done (PIN reset form for managers)
- **Recovery Code Generation** — missing (no UI for recovery code generation)
- **PIN Forgot Screen / Recovery** — missing (no forgot PIN functionality in new app)
- **Auto-Lock After Inactivity** — missing

### **ABSENSI / ATTENDANCE**
- **Mark Attendance (Present/Absent/Late)** — done (attendance page with status buttons)
- **Daily Attendance Log** — done (date-selectable attendance view)
- **Attendance History** — done (attendance data displayed for selected date)
- **Attendance Summary by Cashier** — partial (data shown, summary stats limited)

### **PAYROLL / GAJI**
- **Create Payslip** — done (create-payslip-form in payroll page)
- **Payslip Detail View** — done (payslip detail page with adjustments)
- **Add Adjustments (Bonus/Deductions)** — done (add-adjustment-form per payslip)
- **Payslip Printing** — done (print-button in payslip detail)
- **Payroll History** — done (payroll page shows all payslips)
- **Cashier Daily Rate** — done (daily_rate field in cashiers table)
- **Auto-Calculate from Attendance & Daily Rate** — missing (manual payslip creation, not auto-calculated from shifts)

### **PENGATURAN / SETTINGS**
- **Business Type Selection (F&B/Retail/All)** — partial (enum in DB, selection UI incomplete in new app)
- **Store Name & Information (Address, Phone, NPWP)** — missing (basic business name exists, extended info missing)
- **Store Logo Upload** — missing (no logo upload UI)
- **Tax Settings** — done (TaxServiceForm in settings)
- **Service Charge Settings** — done (in TaxServiceForm)
- **Payment Method Management** — done (add/delete custom methods UI)
- **Printer Settings (Receipt Printer)** — missing (settings form exists but no active connection UI)
- **Kitchen Printer Management** — done (add-printer-form, delete-printer-button)
- **Cashier/PIN Management** — done (full cashier settings)
- **Auto-Lock Configuration** — missing
- **Recovery Code Management** — missing
- **Backup & Restore (Full/Transactions Only)** — missing (no backup/restore UI; new app uses Supabase, not browser localStorage)

### **AKTIVITAS / ACTIVITY LOG**
- **Activity Log Display** — partial (activity page exists but may be incomplete)
- **Log Filtering by Category** — partial (filter UI may not be fully implemented)
- **Log Search** — partial (search capability unclear)
- **Log Statistics** — missing (no stat badges visible)
- **Log Export** — missing

### **BUSINESS TYPE / FEATURE VISIBILITY**
- **F&B-Specific Features (Show/Hide)** — partial (business_type field controls some, but not all visibility)
- **Retail-Specific Features (Show/Hide)** — partial (implemented at DB level, but UI filtering incomplete)
- **Toggle Between Business Types** — missing (no UI to switch after initial selection)

### **DATA MANAGEMENT**
- **Full Data Backup** — missing (new app uses Supabase, not localStorage)
- **Transactions-Only Backup** — missing
- **Backup/Restore from File** — missing
- **Data Import Validation** — missing
- **Auto-Save Indicator** — missing (no "saving..." UI visible)

### **RECEIPT/STRUK FEATURES**
- **Receipt Header (Store Info)** — missing (no receipt printing UI in checkout)
- **Receipt Line Items** — missing (no receipt printing UI)
- **Receipt Payment Summary** — missing
- **Receipt Footer (Daftar Ulang, etc.)** — missing
- **Receipt QR Code** — missing
- **Receipt Print via Browser** — missing
- **Receipt Print via Thermal Printer** — missing
- **Receipt Save as HTML** — missing

## Summary by Module

| Module | Status | Key Missing Features |
|--------|--------|----------------------|
| **POS/Kasir** | 5-10% | Entire checkout UI, cart, barcode scanner, all modals (payment, discount, notes, etc.) |
| **Produk/Inventory** | 70% | Full image upload, barcode scanner, stock threshold alerts |
| **Bahan Baku/Ingredients** | 60% | HPP calculator UI, full recipe consumption tracking |
| **Meja/Self-Order** | 60% | Kitchen printer auto-routing, order status management UI |
| **Printer Dapur** | 40% | Bluetooth pairing, connection testing, auto-print routing |
| **Shift Management** | 50% | Open shift UI, close shift detailed UI, shift reports |
| **Transaksi** | 30% | Transaction detail deep view, reprintable receipts, void from POS |
| **Pembayaran** | 5% | Entire checkout payment modal, split payment UI |
| **Diskon** | 0% | No discount UI implemented |
| **Pajak & Biaya** | 60% | Settings done, but calculation verification & display in checkout missing |
| **Keuangan/Finance** | 50% | Dashboard partial, expense tracking done, reconciliation form basic, COGS comparison incomplete |
| **Laporan/Reports** | 40% | Dashboard partial, Laba-Rugi page exists, charts missing, export limited |
| **Pelanggan** | 70% | CRUD done, history partial, spending summary limited |
| **Kasir** | 80% | CRUD & roles done, forgot PIN missing, auto-lock missing, recovery code missing |
| **Absensi** | 80% | CRUD done, summary stats minimal |
| **Payroll** | 70% | CRUD & printing done, auto-calculation from shifts missing |
| **Pengaturan** | 40% | Some done (tax, custom payment, cashier), logo/store info/backup/recovery missing |
| **Aktivitas** | 30% | Page exists, filtering/search/export unclear or incomplete |
| **Business Type** | 20% | F&B/Retail visibility partial, no UI to toggle after setup |

The new Next.js/Supabase app has solid **backend infrastructure** (migrations cover all major entities) and foundational **CRUD pages** for most modules, but the critical **user-facing UI for point-of-sale operations** (checkout, payments, receipts, printing, discounts) is **largely missing**. The app is approximately **30-40% feature-complete** from a user's perspective, though the database schema supports 70-80% of the intended features.
